description: Component for fetching data from REST APIs.

api_url.label: Api Url
api_url.description: URL of the API endpoint to fetch data from

body.label: Body
body.description: JSON string of request body for POST/PUT requests

json_path.label: Json Path
json_path.description: JSON path to extract data from response (e.g.,

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this asset depends on (e.g. [

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata when output_format is

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: How many rows to include in the preview. Large tables (>10× this number) are sampled randomly.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

response_path.label: Response Path (JMESPath)
response_path.description: JMESPath expression selecting the array of records to iterate. Used with column_map to normalize a nested/heterogeneous API response into a tabular batch. Example: 'output.rateReplyDetails' or 'data.results[?status==`active`]'. Requires: pip install jmespath.

column_map.label: Column Map (JMESPath)
column_map.description: Dict of {output_column: jmespath_expression} evaluated against each element of the array selected by response_path. Produces one row per element with named columns extracted from arbitrary JSON shapes. Requires: pip install jmespath.

endpoints.label: Endpoints (per-partition dispatch)
endpoints.description: Dict keyed by partition_static_dim value (multi-partition) or partition key (single-dim static). When set, overrides api_url/method/headers/params/auth/response_path/column_map for the matching partition. Each endpoint config supports: api_url, method, headers (dict), params (dict), body (JSON string), auth_type, auth_username_env_var, auth_password_env_var, auth_token_env_var, timeout, response_path, column_map. Enables 'N different vendor APIs land in one warehouse table' without custom Python.

sinks.label: Sinks (warehouse writes)
sinks.description: Optional list of table sinks. Each: {kind: table, resource_key: <name>, table: <name>, schema: <optional>, if_exists: append|replace, mode: upsert_on_match, match: [col, col], partition_dim_columns: {output_col: partition_dim_name}}. mode:upsert_on_match gives partition-rewrite idempotency (DELETE-then-INSERT keyed by match, in a transaction). Auto-detects DuckDB .register() fast path (10-100x faster than to_sql); falls back to SQLAlchemy for postgres/snowflake/bigquery/mysql/mssql.

name: REST API Fetcher
